name: single-binary
body: Delivered as one self-contained static `eypres` binary (Go), built for exactly these supported targets: darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64 (no Linux — see supported-platforms). No runtime, network access or install step needed beyond placing the binary (Homebrew/Scoop channels are a convenience). The binary packages the whole tool (authoring/scaffolding, templating, validation, presentation). AC: for every release, `eypres init && eypres start` is verified offline on a native GitHub Actions runner for each of the four targets (see native-ci-verification); cross-compiling alone does not satisfy this AC.
